reaction: The result was satisfying and matched my expectation.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making the awning and securing it with rope was the most worthwhile sequence: the parts had a clear purpose and completed the canopy.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the puppet was the least useful passage for the stated goals, though it was surprising.

surprise.text: Wood and cloth made a puppet when I expected a canopy or frame.

arbitrary.text: The puppet felt somewhat arbitrary because the menu gave no clue that wood and cloth would make one, although the materials are plausible.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter: the puppet was an unexpected outcome, though the main goal sequences were fairly predictable.
